title: Add an InteractionShape that emits configurable events for hit areas and interaction zones
reason: The discussion identifies missing typed arbitrary custom-event support, distinguishes existing click/transform hooks from hover and raw pointer seams, and recommends testing disabled interactions against default canvas behavior. This is a considered SDK extension proposal, not a shipped capability.

varveAssessment.assessment: A potentially useful authoring/API feature, but Varve's shape/tool extensibility and typed action/event contract need source inspection before implementation.

title: Refine tooltip mode to require a brief pause when switching between items
reason: Requests a short delay before switching tooltips while moving across items. The reply says singleton tooltip mode is a deliberate design choice and asks to pause for broader discussion due to possible unintended effects.

varveAssessment.assessment: Tooltip timing change has explicit unresolved design risks; no Varve behavior change is inferred.

title: Add Cloudflare Browser Run thumbnail generation for tldraw.com files
reason: The reply confirms #9503 implemented signed-page rendering via Cloudflare Browser Run, R2 caching, rate limits, and telemetry; #9667 added rendering before first share.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is server-side thumbnail generation for hosted dotcom files, unrelated to Varve's local thumbnail pipeline.

title: Custom record types used with sync need a compatibility guard or documentation
reason: Reports older clients connecting to sync without a custom record type registered and receiving records their local schema cannot represent. The requested guard/documentation concerns a versioned multi-client server contract; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no corresponding hosted multi-version sync service in the reviewed workspace.

title: Can't turn off the i18n debug locale flags from the user menu
reason: Reports debug pseudo-locales in the hosted user menu behaving as one-way switches and a long-string locale with no visible effect. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Upstream-only debug-menu state behavior; no Varve setting equivalent was inspected.

title: Make Escape return to the Select tool consistently
reason: Requests universal Escape-to-Select semantics, replacing the current tool-specific cancel/exit behavior. This is a broad keyboard contract proposal and no discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Changing Escape globally can interfere with nested cancel/exit interactions; no Varve keyboard contract review or reproduction was performed.

title: Gate the app debug flags menu behind dev mode
reason: Requests hiding the hosted app debug flags menu outside local development, noting the pseudo-locale footgun described by #9507. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No corresponding app debug-flags menu was inspected in Varve.

title: Rotate handles shrink too much when zoomed out instead of disappearing
reason: Reports rotation handles scaling down to impractical sizes at far zoom-out instead of hiding behind a threshold. No comments were available and the screenshot was not replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: A visual selection-overlay regression lead; Varve handle sizing was not inspected or validated at low zoom.

title: Cursor chat gives the author no feedback when their message is truncated for collaborators
reason: Explicitly marked as a duplicate created twice by accident; retain its individual record and direct substantive discussion to #9520.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve cursor-chat equivalent is established; the duplicate is preserved without copying upstream conclusions.

title: Cursor chat gives the author no feedback when their message is truncated for collaborators
reason: The sole long comment traces divergence between the uncapped author DOM bubble, a local-only 64-character state cap, and the collaborators' 200-screen-pixel canvas bubble. It proposes aligning display and broadcast limits and specifies tests, including grapheme safety; these findings are upstream collaboration-system analysis.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's collaboration/presence path is not the upstream cursor-chat service. No equivalent UI or broadcast truncation defect was inspected.
